title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — November 06, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C2.3)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C3.4 (Peaked November 06, 2026 at 22:33 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: C5.6 (Peaked November 06, 2026 at 02:51 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 424 km/s (Moderate)
🧲 Bz: +7.5 nT (Northward)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.33)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Things are flickering on the Sun. 💥🌌

Several active regions and sunspots are visible today, along with a broad dark coronal region; no clear large outward structure appears in the coronagraph.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 335 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
